claims.text: On American Alchemy with Jesse Michels, 13 June 2025, at 0:15:15, Michels said a Wall Street Journal journalist he names only as Lena told him that Spergel 'is their de facto advisor on UFOs' and that on his account the objects are all space trash, light reflections and temperature inversions. Michels retold the same anecdote to Ross Coulthart on 21 June 2025 at 0:43:31 and to Richard Dolan on 28 June 2025 at 1:42:04. All three are the same speaker relaying the same unnamed journalist, not three independent sources, and Michels says in the first telling 'I have no smoking gun'.
